clips.ig_caption:
That tree in your yard? It's not just wood. It's a **cosmic flight recorder** 🌲☢️

Scientists found 14 radioactive spikes buried in tree rings—each one a solar storm 1000x stronger than every nuke on Earth combined. The last one hit in 993 AD. We're statistically overdue.

The 774 AD Miyake Event? 10 BILLION megatons of TNT. Our entire nuclear arsenal is a firecracker by comparison.

Tree rings survive. Power grids don't. 12% chance per decade.

**What would you grab first if the lights went out for years?**
